items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels; Mariota starts. Rapoport: good news, not IR.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin retains some target share historically with Mariota but tough SEA matchup.
items.opportunity: McLaurin 25% target share in prior Mariota games.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at Indianapolis.
items.why: Official ruling confirmed by Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Schultz becomes primary pass-catcher with elevated target share.
items.opportunity: Schultz prior 28% target share and high routes/TPRR without Collins; Colts allow high TE yards.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe); Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder).
items.implication: Warren expected to lead backfield with checkdown volume.
items.opportunity: Coach: Warren lead the group; Levitan notes vertical pass not working so spam checkdowns; Homer/Heidenreich backups.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN as of now despite QUESTIONABLE listings. Clarity hoped on Flowers/Moore.
items.why: ETR internal projections based on practice/LP.
items.implication: Start Warren/Evans/Bowers with confidence; monitor early clarity.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full roles if active.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey listed IN; Jonah Coleman OUT. Schefter confirms Dobbins/Harvey off IR report good to go.
items.implication: Broncos RB committee back to Dobbins/Harvey lead; reverse Coleman beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries expected for healthy duo vs Rams.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead the group; vertical pass game not working for Rodgers so expect zillion checkdowns. Projecting Warren in despite Q.
items.why: Coach comments + usage projection; LP practice context.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with high floor via receiving.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in missed games strong (e.g. 8-195-2).
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 upside if Nacua out.
items.opportunity: High target rate and production concentration.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core surgery); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 util).
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week without Collins; Indy allows 4th-most yards to TEs. Also 10 Facts highlight.
items.opportunity: High target/route share as de facto top option.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL: highest rush yards prop (88.5), Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chris Olave (double-digit tgts, high aDOT vs LV high YPR), Christian Watson (WR8 util, RZ share), Chase Brown (20+ touches, 15% tgts, PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs).
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Watson RZ; Brown volume.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson (low snaps/touches post-fumble, tough JAX), Travis Etienne (low touch/snap share even w/ Kamara), Terry McLaurin (SEA fewest WR pts, low team total).
items.opportunity: Henderson rising snaps post-Stevenson fumble; Etienne limited 3rd down.

items.text: 10 Facts: Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched Stevenson 16-5 post-fumble (still ranks Stevenson ahead); London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds avg in 12 games w/ Penix.
items.implication: Monitor Henderson rise; start London confidently w/ Penix.
items.opportunity: Henderson pass-pro still lagging but gap narrowed; London high target share.
